title: Backend owns all machine access; frontend is view-only
context: Repository structure needed a fundamental boundary between what Rust and JavaScript could do.
decision: Rust owns everything that touches the machine: manifests, filesystem operations, processes, PTYs, shell state. Frontend renders snapshots Rust produces and sends verbs back.
consequences: No component imports Tauri API directly; only src/bindings.ts calls invoke. No region imports another region's source. Shared pieces live at src/shell/ level, not in regions. This enforces predictable data flow and testability.
